Company Description

About Redcare Pharmacy:
As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy, Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy, collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values, join us and begin your #Redcareer today.
About the role:
Join our team as a Warehouse Worker (m/f/d) and shape the future of healthcare logistics and earn ca. 1077€ net amount per month for 20h/ week.
Working Hours: You work from Monday till Friday from 6-10 p.m. (18 - 22 o'clock).
Job Description

About your tasks: ✓ You will handle incoming goods and store all incoming products, distributing them appropriately in our warehouse✓ You will precisely pick our products, ensuring the complete processing of customer orders ✓ You will carefully pack customer orders and guarantee a smooth shipping✓
You carry out regular quality checks and ensure that damaged or faulty products are identified and removed at an early stage✓
You keep your work area organized and clean, contributing to a safe and efficient warehouse environment

Qualifications

About you:  ✓ You are an EU citizen or hold a Dutch work permit ✓ You can understand and speak German or English without difficulty ✓ You have a driver’s license and a car or motorcycle, etc., to commute independently to the workplace in Sevenum (Note: There is no public transport connection) ✓ You are able to perform a standing job for up to 8 hours a day and walk more than 15,000 steps ✓ You don’t need years of warehouse experience, as long as you are willing to learn new tasks

Additional Information

About our benefits:
In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs – whether it’s living a healthy life, having enough time for your needs, or developing your skills – we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits:     ✓ Mobility: Not all employees live close to our office. That’s why we support our employees with your daily commute with a travel allowance. This compensation is paid to you in addition to your salary.  ✓ Redcare events: We promote team-building through creative team events, and celebrate our successes together at regularly scheduled parties.  ✓ Vacation: We can offer you 28 vacation days and a vacation pay once per year (8 % of your annual gross) in addition to your salary.  ✓ Employee discount: Several times a year, we offer you discounted employee sales directly at the Sevenum location as well as 10 % off on our assortment for all employees.  ✓ Employee referral program: Because our employees know best who fits in with us, successful recommendations are rewarded with a bonus.

Company

Operating on a global scale through an international sales and distribution network, tk accelis Trading, formerly thyssenkrupp Materials Trading, is your partner for long-term success. With our local contacts around the world we are represented where the customers need us. Our core capabilities embrace complex logistic services for raw and finished steel materials along with supply chain dependability and consultancy for the downstream manufacturing and metalworking industries.

Your responsibilities

Build and scale profitable physical steel trading flows, with particular emphasis on cross-border and third-country trading. Sales market focus is EMEA. We are open to candidates trading steel products, including flat products, long products, semi-finished products, or finished goods (steel derivates). More important than a specific product background is a demonstrable ability to originate repeatable, profitable international trade flows.

- Leverage in-depth commercial and technical knowledge of steel products and specifications to support profitable trading activities.
- Identify, establish, and expand sourcing opportunities and supplier relationships across global markets.
- Build, maintain, and strengthen long-term relationships with customers and suppliers on a national and international level.
- Manage the full trading cycle, including origination, pricing, negotiation, contracting, execution, receivables management, and PundL accountability.
- Develop new procurement and sales channels to drive business growth and increase market penetration.
- Collaborate effectively within a multinational environment while utilizing a strong regional and international network to expand business opportunities.
- Develop and manage a trading book to achieve agreed volume, gross margin, EBIT, working capital, and risk targets.

Your profile

- 8+ years of proven experience in physical steel trading with a strong track record of commercial success.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, combined with a confident and professional presence.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to drive business growth while operating within corporate governance frameworks.
- Strong risk assessment capabilities to support profitable trading decisions.
- High level of integrity and thorough understanding of compliance, sanctions, competition law, and reputational risk considerations.
- Team-oriented professional with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multinational environment; prior leadership experience is an advantage.
- Based in Germany, preferably in Essen, with excellent English language skills; German is a plus.

Here at tk accelis Trading, we are a highly globalised, diverse and dynamic team operating in a challenging yet exciting industry. We offer you the following benefits:

- A competitive compensation package with performance-related incentives

our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and

testing standards, and verify the quality of incoming materials and

The Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy (MPI-SP) in Bochum is a research institute of the Max Planck Society for the Advancement of Science. It conducts interdisciplinary research on the diverse aspects of IT security and data protection. The newly established and expanding institute will ultimately comprise 18 research groups and employ around 200 staff members and guests. The institute cooperates with the Faculty of Computer Science at Ruhr University Bochum. Bochum is one of the world’s leading research locations for cybersecurity and is home to Europe’s largest training center in this field as well as a vibrant start-up scene.

Starting immediately, we are seeking a

Project Coordinator - AI Competition (d/f/m), 50%

to support the organization, communication, and implementation of an AI competition. The competition combines cutting-edge research in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity with the goal of advancing AI-based cybersecurity technologies. Teams from academia, start-ups, and industry will develop autonomous AI-based systems for identifying software vulnerabilities and assessing their exploitability.

The position is part-time (50%) and project-funded until the end of December 2028.

Competition Organization: Coordinate the organizational implementation of the tournament, including deadlines, participant communication, documentation, and organizational workflows.
Participant Management: Serve as an organizational point of contact for participating teams and prospective applicants; coordinate inquiries, registration processes, information materials, and communication throughout the competition.
Event Management: Plan and organize several events, in particular the qualification event and the final tournament. This includes venues, logistics, infrastructure, schedules, invitations, and coordination with external service providers.
Communication and Outreach: Develop and coordinate communication activities to increase awareness of the tournament among universities, research institutions, start-ups, companies, and the broader cybersecurity and AI communities. Identify and address relevant target groups and support targeted outreach activities to attract strong teams.
Website and Communication Materials: Coordinate and prepare content for the project website, newsletters, flyers, posters, social media, and other communication channels.
Public Relations: Coordinate media and public-relations activities around major project milestones and events in collaboration with MPI-SP’s communication structures and the project partners. Support communication and coordination with industry partners, policymakers, and other relevant stakeholders.
Project Coordination: Support meetings, schedules, documentation, reporting, and other organizational aspects of the project and ensure effective communication between the scientific team, project partners, participants, and external stakeholders.

A Master’s degree or comparable qualification, preferably in communication, event management, project management, science management, or a related field.
Experience in project coordination, event organization, communication, or public relations.
Excellent organizational and project-management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple activities and stakeholders simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English.
The ability to communicate professionally with researchers, companies, public-sector organizations, and other external stakeholders.
A proactive, reliable, and solution-oriented working style.
Confidence in using standard digital communication and collaboration tools.

Experience in science communication, research organizations, technology competitions, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, or publicly funded research projects is advantageous but not required.

An independent and varied position at the intersection of cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, re...

Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences
Doctoral Position: Gene Expression Regulation (f/m/x)

Uhlirova Lab | Institute for Genetics | CECAD

We are one of the largest and oldest universities in Europe and one of the most important employers in our region. Our broad range of subjects, the dynamic development of our main research areas and our central location in Cologne make us attractive for students and researchers from around the world. We offer a wide range of career opportunities in science, technology, and administration.

The Uhlirova lab (www.uni-koeln.de/inter-fak/cecad/uhlirova/) explores how stress-inducible signaling pathways control gene expression and influence tissue homeostasis and longevity. To tackle these questions, we combine the power of functional genetics in Drosophila and mouse models with cutting-edge molecular and cell biology, multi-omics approaches, advanced microscopy, and bioinformatics. We are looking for a highly motivated and curious doctoral candidate (f/m/x) to join our dynamic team. You will have the opportunity to lead your own project, contribute to collaborative research, and develop skills at the interface of genetics, molecular and cell biology, and systems-level analysis.

The University of Cologne promotes equal opportunities and diversity. Women will be considered preferentially in accordance with the Equal Opportunities Act of North Rhine-Westphalia (Landesgleichstellungsgesetz - LGG NRW). We also expressly welcome applications from all suitable candidates regardless of their gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, disability, age, personal orientation and identity.

The position is available from immediately on a part-time basis (25,89 hours per week).The position is to be filled for three years. If the applicant meets the relevant wage requirements and personal qualifications, the salary is based on remuneration group 13 TV-L of the pay scale for the German public sector.

Please apply online without a photo with proof of the required
qualifications and the following documents:

A cover letter describing your motivation to join our research group and information on your career achievements (1 page max.)
Academic Curriculum Vitae, including your publication list and contact information for three references
Copies of your degree and qualification certificate

The reference number is Wiss2608-13. The application deadline is 27 September 2026.
For further inquiries, please contact Dr Esther Wollert (uhlirova-jobs@uni-koeln.de) and take a look at our FAQs. YOUR TASKS

To study the crosstalk between transcription and pre-mRNA splicing under physiological, stress, and disease conditions

PhD Candidate (f/m/x) in Ophthalmic Epidemiology
Code: 1547/2026/5

full-time, 3 years, extension possible
Site: Bonn

The German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE) is a globally leading, internationally oriented research institution dedicated to discovering new approaches for the prevention and treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. Conduct research in ophthalmic epidemiology of aging in humans, with a focus on age-related macular degeneration. In particular, we expect you to:

Perform integrative analyses combining multi-omics data with eye imaging data
Contribute to ophthalmic data collection and processing
Contribute to omics data processing, statistical analyses, and the preparation of manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals
Present research findings at national and international conferences
Actively participate in project-related meetings, documentation, and reporting of project progress
Contribute to ongoing projects within the group and develop independent research ideas

A Master’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field, such as epidemiology, bioinformatics, medicine, biomedical sciences, or a related discipline
A genuine interest in scientific research and quantitative analysis
Strong proficiency in written and spoken English
Statistical knowledge and experience with programming in R
Experience with epidemiological research or large-scale observational studies, particularly involving omics and eye imaging data, including the application of machine learning methods for pattern recognition and predictive modeling is desirable but not a prerequisite
Strong analytical skills, independent and critical thinking, and attention to detail
Flexibility, strong interpersonal skills, and enjoyment of working in an interdisciplinary and international team
Proficiency in written and spoken German

Your role in Cutting-Edge Research

The PhD project will be supervised by Dr. Dr. Petra Larsen, scientific lead of the ophthalmic epidemiology team. The research is embedded in the large population-based Rhineland Study, a comprehensive long-term cohort investigating determinants of brain health. We are seeking an enthusiastic and ambitious early-career researcher (f/m/x) with a strong interest in investigating multi-omic and eye imaging signatures in the context of age-related macular degeneration.

The Ophthalmic Epidemiology research team investigates deep phenotyping of retinal ageing, preclinical changes and disease, as well as the comprehensive assessment of risk factors driving the onset and progression of both preclinical and clinical disease. These include genetic, molecular and environmental factors.

The PhD thesis will focus on the relationship between ageing and age-related macular degeneration and encompass the full breadth of scientific work, including the development and implementation of study protocols, coordination and supervision of data collection, and data analysis and publication.

The project will leverage data from the Rhineland Study, a deeply-phenotyped, large-scale population-based cohort study. Available data include comprehensive multi-omics data, including (epi)genomics, transcriptomics, metabolomics, lipidomics, and proteomics; eye imaging data, advanced MRI data as well as extensive behavioral and clinical data, including cognitive and neurological assessments, cardiovascular assessments, medical history, and medication use. The study currently includes over 14,000 individuals, of whom more than 6,000 already have longitudinal data. Additional baseline and follow-up data collection is ongoing.

You will dive into the synthesis and characterization of novel battery materials that go far beyond conventional lithium-ion systems. This interdisciplinary PhD project addresses central challenges of the energy transition, including alternative battery chemistries (e.g., sodium-ion, magnesium-based systems), solid-state electrolytes, and circular recycling strategies

Job requirements and responsibilities:

 Designing and characterizing novel electrode materials or electrolytes for post-Li technologies

 Advancing circular battery concepts (e.g., direct recycling, recovery of critical raw materials)

 Fabrication of battery electrodes (water-based binder systems, dry electrodes, free-standing)

 Structural and electrochemical characterization using state-of-the-art instrumentation, including X-ray diffraction,

Raman spectroscopy, and Scanning electron microscopy

 Active participation in the research activities of the group and collaboration with external partners

 Publish scientific papers and present results at international conferences

Your academic qualifications:

 Completed scientific university studies in Chemistry, Materials Science, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or related

fields

 Language skills (according to GER): English (C1)

The successful candidate will also be expected to:

 Hands-on experience in electrochemistry, material characterization (e.g., XRD, SEM, BET), or process engineering

is advantageous

 Strong motivation for sustainable technologies and interdisciplinary collaboration

 Independent, analytical mindset and proficiency in English
